lines.zh: 我一脚踩进自己的泥坑
lines.en: I step into my own mud wallow.

lines.zh: 我身上的泥还在往下滴
lines.en: Mud still drips off my hide.

lines.zh: 我慢慢穿过平原的草地
lines.en: I wander across the plains grass.
My hooves sink into soft earth.
I shuffle to the next patch of mud.
The mud on my back dries and cracks.

lines.zh: 我走一路，地上一点一点
lines.en: I leave little drops the whole way.
I walk with my snout to the ground.
I turn my head at a puddle.
I drift toward the field edge.
Every few steps I want to lie down.
My tail flicks drops of mud.
I rub my back on the grass.
I amble toward that clay.
My shadow is short and stubby.
I walk, and bits of mud flake off.
I lie still; the mud is cool.
Soaking in mud is the best.
I do not want to move at all.
The mud covers my itches.
I grunt and roll over.
I sniff the smell of earth.
This mud has a good texture.
My eyes are only half open.
I want to soak a while longer.

lines.zh: 有虫在我背上的泥里爬
lines.en: A bug crawls in the mud on my back.
I flick my ears.
The mud hardens slowly in the sun.
I hold still like a heap of mud.
I squeal once, then fall quiet.
I roll to the other side, the cool side.
Life is good.
Are you getting in too?
I am all mud, do not mind.
I lift my eyes to you.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西是吃的吗
lines.en: Is that food in your hand?
There is mud on my snout.

lines.zh: 我从鼻子里朝你哼了一声
lines.en: I grunt at you through my snout.
I am too comfortable to get up.

lines.zh: 你站那儿，我就这样看你
lines.en: Stand there; I will watch from here.
My ears twitch.
Are you going to pet me?
I slowly right myself.
The wallow is big enough for you too.
Startled, I shrink back.
A chunk of my mud falls off.
My grunt comes out long and pitiful.
That landed on my rump.
All four of my legs are unsteady.
I shake the mud off.
My squeal comes out high.
I retreat toward the wallow.
My hide is thick, but it still hurts.
Let me get my breath back first.
I smell it; that is food.
I push myself up on four legs.
I do not even shake the mud off.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过去，一步一晃
lines.en: I waddle toward you.
Put it down, reaching is too much work.
I grunt while I eat.
One bite will not be enough.
I nudge your hand with my snout.
A little more and I will still soak.
I will chew and go lie down again.
I follow the smell.
Walk slower, I am fat.
This will not fill me.
I shake mud onto your feet.
I look up, waiting for another.
Done, and I want more.
You bumped into my wet mud.
I slip and nearly fall over.
You wiped off some of my mud.
I am heavy; I will not be knocked aside.
Do not push, I am not steady yet.
Now we are both muddy.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩在我的蹄子上了
lines.en: You put your foot on my hoof.
I grunt and shift aside.
This time I really did slip.

lines.zh: 地上的泥被我蹭开一片
lines.en: I smear the ground with mud.
Let us go wallow together.
Her mud coat is thicker than mine.
We lie side by side in the mud.
This wallow fits us both.

lines.zh: 我替她把背上的泥蹭匀
lines.en: I help spread the mud on her back.
We grunt the same tune.
I keep watch by the wallow.
When she moves, the mud squelches.
We are equally filthy.
This is a good life.
In the mud, I eat it.
I root it up with my snout.
It is coated in mud.
I swallow it without even chewing.
I drag it off in my teeth.
Too hard for me.
I roll it into the wallow.
Whoever dropped it, I eat first.
I sniff; it smells of dirt.
I shovel it aside.
You are taking my wallow.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，第一次这么认真
lines.en: I stare at you, serious for once.
I have stood up out of the mud.
I claimed this mud hole first.
My snout puffs air.
Stop where you are, no closer.

lines.zh: 我哼得半个草场都听得见
lines.en: My grunt carries across the meadow.
I am ready to butt you.

lines.zh: 泥坑还热着，我还没泡够
lines.en: The wallow is still warm, and I am not done.
I plant myself across the wallow.
I lower my head at you.
I push forward, shoving the mud aside.
Do not back into my mud.
I lower my head and point my snout at you.
My breathing grows heavier.
I'm soaking in my mud — stay away.
One more step and I charge.
My hoof scrapes the ground.
I guard the wallow and will not yield.
Last warning.
I butt into you.
Not heavy, but very sticky.
Now you have mud on you too.
I charge and slip myself.
I headbutt your knee.
Mud splatters all over you.
I grunt; that settles it.
I go back to soaking.
Do not think fat means slow.
I held back on that one.
I rise out of the wallow.
The plains have gained a coat of mud.
This wallow suits me perfectly.
I rooted my way here.
I shake, and mud flies.
The puddle here is big enough.
First I checked the soil.
I walk out into the sun.
My snout touched ground first.
Nobody minds me here.
Fire bakes my mud shell.
I rolled down the slope.
Muddy water fills my snout.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从泥里掀起来
lines.en: The blast lifts me out of the mud.

lines.zh: 背上挨了一下，我哼出声
lines.en: Something strikes my back and I squeal.

lines.zh: 魔法打在身上，泥都发烫
lines.en: Magic makes the mud on me hot.
I have not eaten in a long while.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我跳起来
lines.en: Lightning strikes nearby and I jump.
The wallow is suddenly gone.
